C45027.observed: What was checked: whether saving a change to an existing part also opens a new blank row, the way saving a brand new part does. What happened: the quantity on an existing part was changed and saved. The row closed and that was the end of it - no new empty row appeared underneath. That is the right difference: when you are adding parts you usually have another one to add, but when you are correcting one part you are finished.

C45030.observed: What was checked: what happens if, while editing an existing part, you pick a completely different part out of the catalogue list. What happened: with the quantity typed as 6, a different catalogue part was chosen from the Part number list. The row was refilled from the newly chosen part - its description and its part number both replaced what was there before - while the quantity 6 was left exactly as typed, and the cursor moved to the quantity box. So choosing a different part deliberately overwrites the part's own details, which is the one place where that is meant to happen, but it never quietly changes the quantity you asked for.
C45030.not_observed: Cost, sell price and category are not shown at all in Tech view, so whether they are refilled could not be seen from this view; that is covered by the Full View cases.
